name: soft_constraint1.k
model:
class Preference {
  x:Int
  y:Int

  req x >= 0

  req x <= 100

  req y >= 0

  req y <= 100

  soft req x + y = 50

  soft req x = y
}

pref:Preference
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (pref Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Preference (mk-Preference (x Int)(y Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Preference (sel-Preference Preference))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Preference ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Preference (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Preference ((this Ref)) Preference
  (sel-Preference (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Preference ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Preference this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.pref: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!pref ((this Ref)) Ref
  (pref (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class Preference:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for Preference.x: ---

(define-fun Preference!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-Preference this))
)

; --- getters for Preference.y: ---

(define-fun Preference!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-Preference this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Preference (TopLevelDeclarations!pref this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Preference:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Preference Preference)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Preference.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Preference!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Preference.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Preference.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (Preference!x this) 100)
)

(assert (! (Preference.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Preference.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Preference!y this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Preference.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Preference.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (Preference!y this) 100)
)

(assert (! (Preference.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Soft Constraint 5: ---

(define-fun Preference.soft5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (+ (Preference!x this) (Preference!y this)) 50)
)

(assert-soft (Preference.soft5 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft5)

; --- Soft Constraint 6: ---

(define-fun Preference.soft6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Preference!x this) (Preference!y this))
)

(assert-soft (Preference.soft6 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft6)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Preference const-1-Preference))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-Preference () Preference
  (mk-Preference 0 43))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-Preference (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (y (sel-Preference (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (pref (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Preference a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-Preference (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (y (sel-Preference (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-Preference (mk-Preference 0 43))))
